topic: Brazil frequency model implementation on staging
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on implementing a specific frequency calculation for Brazil (company numbers 7885, 7887). It was decided that this frequency model should be applied to the staging environment without splitting by category. This approach is intended to test how the ML API functions with airport data.

[p1] confirmed that the existing logic structure using `companyNum IN (7885, 7887)` and a specific dictionary lookup for frequency was correct. [me] noted that implementing the requested change might temporarily reduce the speed of analytics opening for Brazilian users.

Later, it was reaffirmed that the staging environment must use the ML API frequency calculation for these two companies regardless of the category, to properly test airport functionality.
decisions: The frequency model for Brazil (companies 7885, 7887) will be implemented on the staging environment.
The frequency calculation should not be split by category, even when testing with airport data.
action_items: Review and adjust the task regarding the airport implementation (to be discussed with Nina).
